observations: Photo 0: one top-down shot of an adult mountain-style bicycle leaning against a wall on a concrete floor.
Photo 0: olive green frame, front suspension fork, flat handlebar with rubber grips, brake levers and what look like trigger gear shifters.
Photo 0: front wheel with knobby tyre, rim brakes, black front mudguard, pedal visible on the left.
Photo 0: no brand name, model or frame size is readable on the frame or fork.
Photo 0: rear wheel, chain, chainring, rear derailleur and saddle are out of frame or not clearly visible.
Photo 0: a marketplace watermark is laid over the image; tyre tread looks usable and no obvious rust is visible on the parts shown.

identity.kind: adult mountain bike with front suspension and gears
read_from: photo 0 whole bicycle, no brand readable

claims.evidence: Strength and durability cannot be judged from a photo; no brand or frame material is readable.
Photo 0 shows only the front half from above; the rear wheel, drivetrain, saddle and frame welds are not shown, and nothing shows the gears or brakes working.

risks.risk: Gears do not shift or the chain and rear derailleur are worn or damaged
risks.proof: Short clip of the rear wheel spinning on a stand while the seller runs through every gear
risks.if_unproven: as needing a drivetrain service and new chain

risks.proof: Clip of the bike being pushed and stopped with each brake lever in turn
risks.if_unproven: as needing brake pads and cables

risks.risk: Cracked or bent frame or fork, or a buckled rear wheel
risks.proof: Clear side-on photo of the whole bike from the drive side plus a clip of both wheels spinning
risks.if_unproven: as fair used condition with wheel truing needed

risks.risk: Front suspension fork seized or leaking
risks.proof: Clip of the seller pressing down hard on the handlebar to compress the fork
risks.if_unproven: as a rigid fork with no working suspension

risks.proof: Purchase receipt or photo of the frame serial number under the bottom bracket
risks.if_unproven: as no proof of ownership, flagged for agent check on collection

proof_requests: Clear side-on photo of the whole bike from the chain side in daylight
Clip of the rear wheel spinning while every gear is shifted
Clip of both brakes stopping the bike
Close photo of any brand decal on the down tube and the wheel size printed on the tyre wall
Photo of the frame serial number under the bottom bracket
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows an adult front-suspension mountain bike with gears, so it can be priced by type at its worst case as an unbranded used bike with unproven gears and brakes. Better photos of the drivetrain and a working clip would raise it.
